description:
Measure the numeric difference between original and corrected values:
    how much lies along the supplied linear rule directions (projection) and
    how much lies outside them (residual), with per-field contributions.
    Diagnostic only: it does not establish a cause, and neither record is
    verified. Use with a known-correct version to diff against; use
    analyze_anomaly when you only have the suspicious payload.
    Diagnostics-tier tool.
